source_subproject: JacHacks Spring entry DepGraph (https://github.com/shaileshdev4/depgraph, upstream HEAD 8ae8de42a393bf317f7a6fe252c0396be103bcda at recipe time)
scope: backend graph nodes, in-memory package risk scoring, graph snapshot building and the RemediationWalker; excludes components (UI), main.jac UI, LLM routing/report walkers and all network tools (GitHub, OSV, NVD).
adaptation: graph/nodes.jac verbatim. tools/risk_scorer.jac: removed the unused line 'import from tools.jac_coerce { as_list }' (tools/jac_coerce.py is a repo-local Python module, not in the dataset). graph/snapshot_util.jac: removed 'import from ..tools.jac_coerce { as_list }', replaced the two calls as_list(parsed.get("packages", [])) / as_list(parsed.get("edges", [])) with list(...) (upstream as_list returns the value if it is a list, else []), and changed 'import from ..tools.risk_scorer' back to the upstream 'import from tools.risk_scorer'. walkers/remediation_walker.jac: changed the repaired 'import from ..graph.nodes' back to the upstream 'import from graph.nodes'; the result is byte-identical to upstream (sha256 prefix fca2b324c346 = original_sha). Reason for the import reverts: the repair sweep's '..' relative imports pass jac check but fail at runtime with 'ImportError: attempted relative import beyond top-level package' when imported from the workspace root. main.jac is new: a 6-line thin module that only imports/re-exports the slice (the source main.jac is a UI entry importing out-of-slice walkers and a Python runner). jac.toml is new: minimal [project] service config.
independent_acceptance_adaptation: Written fresh for this recipe (the source has no Jac tests for these modules). Five deterministic tests with unique revdev-* package/CVE names; nodes are built in memory and walkers are spawned on Package nodes, so persisted root state does not affect results.
split_reason: Assigned by the wave-1 brief; repository-level split group.
